meta.title: Third search sweep (2026-11-01): candidate nodes and ties with provenance
meta.status: collection only; nothing here is on the map or in data/. Candidates need review before any of them is added.
meta.how_built: Every claim from the three batch files whose excerpt was found by script in the page text (or the reader's extract), and whose two sides are a map entity or a named person, organisation, public body, company, party or event, becomes evidence on a candidate tie. Claims with the same two sides, kind and label are merged into one tie with all their evidence. no_link findings are listed separately, one entry per page and subject with every object checked. A claim whose subject or object is a list of map entities (for example two judges who filed one notification) gives one tie per entity, each noting this. Claims whose excerpt was not found, or that the cross-check found not supported, are kept under leads_to_check.unverified_claims.
meta.node_ids: Map entities keep their map id. New entities get "new:" plus a slug of the name, with notes in brackets, personal titles of people (dr, prof, judge, minister and the like) and company-form endings (sp. z o.o., S.A., Inc. and the like) left out. Other spelling variants of one name are not merged, so check names_seen.
meta.documents: An appeal, open letter, petition or joint statement signed by several people or organisations is kept as a node of type document, so its signers are linked through it.
meta.labels: fact | alleged | speculation | unproven_conspiracy | no_link, as in the batch files.
meta.cross_check: Batch 04: a skeptical checker read each claim against the page text around its excerpt and gave a verdict: supported, partly_supported or not_supported, plus whether the label fits. Present on evidence items as cross_check.
